cn_steps: 启用 `GDK Net Driver`（模块 `GDKNetDriver`），面向 GDK / Xbox 平台。
在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 的 `[/Script/Engine.Engine]` 或网络设置里把 NetDriver 指向 GDK 实现，替换默认 UDP NetDriver。
构建并部署到 GDK 目标，联机时确认走的是 GDK 网络栈。
只对 GDK 平台生效；其他平台不要依赖 `GDKNetDriver`。
en_steps: Enable `GDK Net Driver` (module `GDKNetDriver`); it targets GDK / Xbox platforms.
Point the NetDriver at the GDK implementation in `DefaultEngine.ini` networking settings instead of the default UDP driver.
Build and deploy to a GDK target and confirm online play uses the GDK network stack.
It only applies to GDK platforms; do not depend on `GDKNetDriver` elsewhere.
note_cn: GDK 平台专用网络驱动，替换默认 NetDriver。
note_en: A GDK-only net driver that replaces the default NetDriver.

cn_steps: 启用 `GDK Package Chunk Installer`（模块 `GDKPackageChunkInstall`），面向 GDK / Xbox。
在打包时为内容划分 chunk，运行时用 XPackage / chunk installer API 按需下载并安装。
在游戏代码里查询 chunk 安装状态，处理下载进度与可用性判断。
只在 GDK 目标使用；其他平台用各自的 DLC/分块方案。
en_steps: Enable `GDK Package Chunk Installer` (module `GDKPackageChunkInstall`) for GDK / Xbox.
Split content into chunks at packaging, then download and install on demand via the XPackage / chunk installer API at runtime.
Query chunk install state in game code and handle download progress and availability.
Use it on GDK targets only; other platforms use their own DLC/chunk solutions.
note_cn: GDK 的 XPackage 分块安装，不是通用补丁/DLC 系统。
note_en: GDK XPackage chunked installs, not a generic patch/DLC system.

cn_steps: 启用 `GDK Virtual Keyboard`（模块 `GDKVirtualKeyboard`），面向 GDK / Xbox。
当 Slate 文本框需要输入时调用平台虚拟键盘接口，处理返回的文本与提交/取消。
在需要输入的 UI（登录、取名等）里接入该接口，替代在主机上无法直接用的物理键盘输入。
只在 GDK 平台使用；其他平台用系统自带输入法。
en_steps: Enable `GDK Virtual Keyboard` (module `GDKVirtualKeyboard`) for GDK / Xbox.
When a Slate text box needs input, call the platform virtual keyboard interface and handle returned text plus submit/cancel.
Wire it into input UIs (login, naming, etc.) as a substitute for physical keyboard input unavailable on console.
Use it on GDK platforms only; other platforms use their native input methods.
note_cn: 主机上没有物理键盘时的文本输入方案，服务 Slate。
note_en: Text entry for consoles without a physical keyboard; serves Slate.

cn_steps: 启用 `GeneSplicer Plugin`（模块 `GeneSplicerLib`、`GeneSplicerModule`，测试模块 `GeneSplicerLibTest`）。
用于面部动画：准备 GeneSplicer 相关数据/绑定，在面部动画管线里接入该插件。
把 GeneSplicer 输出的面部驱动接到骨架/动画蓝图，PIE 看面部表情是否正确。
运行时依赖 `GeneSplicerLib` / `GeneSplicerModule`；测试模块不要进游戏包。
en_steps: Enable `GeneSplicer Plugin` (modules `GeneSplicerLib`, `GeneSplicerModule`; test module `GeneSplicerLibTest`).
For facial animation, prepare the GeneSplicer data/rig and hook the plugin into the facial animation pipeline.
Feed GeneSplicer output into the skeleton/AnimBP and PIE to verify facial expressions.
Runtime depends on `GeneSplicerLib` / `GeneSplicerModule`; keep the test module out of the cooked game.
note_cn: 面部动画专用的 GeneSplicer 插件，不是通用骨骼动画系统。
note_en: A GeneSplicer plugin for facial animation, not a general skeletal animation system.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Geometry Cache from Alembic File`（模块 `GeometryCacheAbcFile`）。
无需先导入：直接把 `.abc` Alembic 文件作为几何缓存引用/导入到关卡。
在 Sequencer 里播放或挂到组件上查看动画几何体，检查帧范围与单位。
Experimental：接口可能变动；稳定管线可先导成 Geometry Cache 资产。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Geometry Cache from Alembic File` (module `GeometryCacheAbcFile`).
Skip the pre-import step: reference/import the `.abc` Alembic file directly as geometry cache.
Play it in Sequencer or attach it to a component; check frame range and units.
Experimental: contract may change; for stable pipelines you can bake to a Geometry Cache asset first.
note_cn: 直接从 Alembic 读几何缓存（免导入），与标准 Geometry Cache 导入路径互补。
note_en: Reads geometry cache straight from Alembic without a pre-import; complements the standard Geometry Cache import path.

cn_steps: 启用 `Geometry Cache`（模块 `GeometryCache`、`GeometryCacheStreamer`、`GeometryCacheTracks`，编辑器 `GeometryCacheEd`、`GeometryCacheSequencer`）。
导入烘焙好的几何缓存资产（如 Alembic 导入得到的），挂到 Geometry Cache 组件上。
在 Sequencer 里用 Geometry Cache Track 编排播放，或用 Streaming 处理大缓存。
运行时依赖 `GeometryCache` / `GeometryCacheStreamer`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Geometry Cache` (modules `GeometryCache`, `GeometryCacheStreamer`, `GeometryCacheTracks`; editor `GeometryCacheEd`, `GeometryCacheSequencer`).
Import a baked geometry cache asset (e.g. from Alembic) and attach it to a Geometry Cache component.
Sequence it with a Geometry Cache Track in Sequencer, or use streaming for large caches.
Runtime depends on `GeometryCache` / `GeometryCacheStreamer`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 精炼的顶点动画几何缓存播放，不是骨骼动画。
note_en: Playback of distilled vertex-animation geometry cache, not skeletal animation.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Geometry Dataflow Nodes`（模块 `GeometryDataflowNodes`、`DataflowMedialSkeleton`）。
在 Dataflow 图里加入这些几何处理节点，对网格做生成/变形/处理。
编译 Dataflow 图，把结果输出到目标资产（如网格、骨架等）。
Experimental：节点接口可能变动；它是 Dataflow 图里的几何节点包。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Geometry Dataflow Nodes` (modules `GeometryDataflowNodes`, `DataflowMedialSkeleton`).
Add these geometry-processing nodes into a Dataflow graph to generate/deform/process meshes.
Compile the Dataflow graph and output the result to the target asset (mesh, skeleton, etc.).
Experimental: node contracts may change; it is a geometry node pack for Dataflow graphs.
note_cn: Dataflow 里的几何处理节点，不是运行时几何库。
note_en: Geometry-processing nodes inside Dataflow, not a runtime geometry library.

cn_steps: 启用 `Geometry Mask`（运行时 `GeometryMask`，编辑器 `GeometryMaskEditor`），属 Virtual Production。
在虚拟制片场景里用几何遮罩对摄像机画面做区域遮挡/裁切（如 LED 墙外区域）。
在编辑器里用 `GeometryMaskEditor` 绘制/编辑遮罩形状，绑定到对应输出。
运行时依赖 `GeometryMask`；`GeometryMaskEditor` 只用于编辑器。
en_steps: Enable `Geometry Mask` (runtime `GeometryMask`, editor `GeometryMaskEditor`); it is Virtual Production.
In a virtual production scene, use a geometry mask to occlude/crop camera view regions (e.g. outside the LED wall).
Draw/edit the mask shape with `GeometryMaskEditor` in the editor and bind it to the matching output.
Runtime depends on `GeometryMask`; `GeometryMaskEditor` is editor-only.
note_cn: 虚拟制片的几何遮罩，用于摄像机画面裁切/遮挡。
note_en: A virtual production geometry mask for camera view crop/occlusion.

cn_steps: 启用 `Geometry Processing`（模块 `GeometryAlgorithms`、`DynamicMesh`、`MeshFileUtils`）。
在 C++/蓝图里用 `DynamicMesh` 与 `GeometryAlgorithms` 对网格做切割、布尔、简化、法线等处理。
用 `MeshFileUtils` 做网格文件的读写/转换，把处理结果落成资产。
这是运行时几何算法库，Game 模块依赖对应模块即可。
en_steps: Enable `Geometry Processing` (modules `GeometryAlgorithms`, `DynamicMesh`, `MeshFileUtils`).
In C++/Blueprint use `DynamicMesh` and `GeometryAlgorithms` to cut, boolean, simplify, and recompute normals on meshes.
Use `MeshFileUtils` to read/write and convert mesh files, saving results as assets.
It is a runtime geometry algorithm library; game modules depend on the relevant submodules.
note_cn: 处理 2D/3D 几何的数据结构与算法底座，DynamicMesh 与 Geometry Script 都建立在其上。
note_en: The data-structure/algorithm base for 2D/3D geometry; DynamicMesh and Geometry Script build on it.

cn_steps: 启用 `Geometry Script`（运行时 `GeometryScriptingCore`，编辑器 `GeometryScriptingEditor`）。
在蓝图或 Python 里调用 Geometry Script 函数库，对 DynamicMesh 做生成与编辑（布尔、挤出、倒角等）。
把脚本结果转成 StaticMesh 资产或直接用于关卡；编辑器工具默认不进 Shipping。
运行时依赖 `GeometryScriptingCore`；`GeometryScriptingEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Geometry Script` (runtime `GeometryScriptingCore`, editor `GeometryScriptingEditor`).
Call the Geometry Script function library from Blueprint or Python to generate/edit a DynamicMesh (boolean, extrude, bevel, etc.).
Convert the script result to a StaticMesh asset or use it in-level; editor tools do not ship.
Runtime depends on `GeometryScriptingCore`; `GeometryScriptingEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 蓝图/Python 的网格生成与编辑函数库，编辑器侧居多。
note_en: A Blueprint/Python mesh generation and editing library, mostly editor-side.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Geometry Toolset`（模块 `GeometryToolset`），它面向 AI Toolset Registry，仅限编辑。
让 AI 助手生成 DynamicMesh Actor、附加原始形体（盒/柱/锥/球/胶囊/环），并用布尔运算组合。
它设计为基础工具集，可与 BlockoutToolset 等其它工具集组合使用。
仅限编辑器，不要打包进游戏；Experimental，接口可能变动。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Geometry Toolset` (module `GeometryToolset`); it targets the AI Toolset Registry and is editor-only.
Let AI assistants spawn DynamicMesh actors, append primitive shapes (box/cylinder/cone/sphere/capsule/torus), and combine them with booleans.
It is designed as a base toolset that composes with others like BlockoutToolset.
Editor-only, never ship it; Experimental with a contract that may change.
note_cn: 给 AI 助手用的程序化几何工具集，仅限编辑。
note_en: A procedural geometry toolset for AI assistants, editor-only.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Geometry`（模块 `GeometryCollectionEditor`、`GeometryCollectionTracks`、`GeometryCollectionSequencer`、`GeometryCollectionNodes` 等）。
用于几何集合（Geometry Collection）容器及其 Chaos 破坏/碎裂管线。
在编辑器里创建 Geometry Collection、设置碎裂，再在 Sequencer 里用其轨道编排。
Experimental：接口可能变动；编辑器模块不要进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Geometry` (modules `GeometryCollectionEditor`, `GeometryCollectionTracks`, `GeometryCollectionSequencer`, `GeometryCollectionNodes`, etc.).
Use it for Geometry Collection containers and the Chaos destruction/fracture pipeline.
Create a Geometry Collection in the editor, set up fracturing, then sequence it with its tracks in Sequencer.
Experimental: contract may change; keep editor modules off Game targets.
note_cn: 几何集合容器与 Chaos 破坏管线，和 Geometry Cache 不是一回事。
note_en: Geometry Collection containers plus the Chaos destruction pipeline, distinct from Geometry Cache.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `GeometryCacheLevelSequenceBaker`（模块 `GeometryCacheLevelSequenceBaker`）。
在关卡序列（Level Sequence）里选中要烘焙的骨架网格动画，运行烘焙命令。
把骨骼动画结果烘成 Geometry Cache 资产，交由 `Geometry Cache` 播放。
这是编辑器烘焙工具；Experimental，接口可能变动。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `GeometryCacheLevelSequenceBaker` (module `GeometryCacheLevelSequenceBaker`).
In a Level Sequence, select the skeletal-mesh animation to bake and run the bake command.
Bake the skeletal animation into a Geometry Cache asset for `Geometry Cache` playback.
It is an editor bake tool; Experimental with a contract that may change.
note_cn: 把关卡序列里的骨骼动画烘成几何缓存，不是运行时组件。
note_en: Bakes skeletal animation in Level Sequence into geometry cache; not a runtime component.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `GeometryFlow`（模块 `GeometryFlowCore`、`GeometryFlowMeshProcessing`、`GeometryFlowMeshProcessingEditor`）。
搭建几何数据流图，对网格做流式处理（生成、变换、合并等）。
Graph 编译运行后输出网格结果；编辑器节点用 `GeometryFlowMeshProcessingEditor`。
Experimental：接口可能变动；核心模块可运行时用，Editor 模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `GeometryFlow` (modules `GeometryFlowCore`, `GeometryFlowMeshProcessing`, `GeometryFlowMeshProcessingEditor`).
Build geometry dataflow graphs to stream-process meshes (generate, transform, merge, etc.).
Compile and run the graph to output mesh results; editor nodes use `GeometryFlowMeshProcessingEditor`.
Experimental: contract may change; core modules can run at runtime, editor modules go to Editor targets.
note_cn: 几何数据流图，思路类似 Dataflow 但聚焦网格流处理。
note_en: A geometry dataflow graph, Dataflow-like but focused on mesh stream processing.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `GeometryMode`（模块 `GeometryMode`、`BspMode`、`TextureAlignMode`）并重启。
在编辑器模式工具栏里切换到几何/BSP 编辑模式，对 Brush 与 BSP 几何做编辑。
用 Texture Align 模式对齐几何体上的纹理坐标。
这是编辑器工具，只能进 Editor Target，不要加进游戏运行时。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `GeometryMode` (modules `GeometryMode`, `BspMode`, `TextureAlignMode`) and restart.
Switch to the geometry/BSP editing mode in the editor mode toolbar to edit brushes and BSP geometry.
Use the Texture Align mode to align texture coordinates on geometry.
It is an editor tool for Editor targets only; never add it to a game runtime.
note_cn: 经典 BSP/几何编辑与纹理对齐工具，纯编辑器。
note_en: Classic BSP/geometry editing and texture-align tools, editor-only.
